channel.title: Helpjuice incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Helpjuice's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Read-Only Mode Activated [resolved]
item.description:
The security incident identified earlier today has been fully resolved. The unauthorized modification has been removed from all affected accounts, content delivery caches have been purged, the compromised access has been revoked, and all platform functionality — including administrative access — was restored as of 15:45 UTC.
Affected customers have been notified directly by email with account-specific details, including a full incident report. Our forensic review of the incident's full scope is continuing as an additional verification step; if it identifies anything relevant to a specific account, we will contact that customer directly.
Questions: support@helpjuice.com.
